headline: Overhead-ish energy but 17mph onshore has it blown — wait it out.
today: Good SSE angle and 4-5ft faces, but 16-17mph S onshore through the morning kills it. Afternoon eases to cross-on and the evening WSW at 7mph is the least-bad window if you're desperate. Save your energy for tomorrow.

daysToWatch.note: Light N-to-E winds dawn and morning make for glassy 2.2-3.2ft at 6s on a good angle. Cleanest and best day of the stretch — fish or groveler, go early before the SE cross-on.
